a.description: array_like, MaskedArray The array to mask. If not a MaskedArray instance (or if no array elements are masked), the result is a MaskedArray with `mask` set to `nomask` (False). Must be a 2D array.
constraints: Input array 'a' and output MaskedArray must have the same shape.

axis.description: int, optional Axis along which to perform the operation. If None, applies to a flattened version of the array.
constraints: Must be an int or None.

output.description: ------- MaskedArray A modified version of the input array, masked depending on the value of the `axis` parameter.
